title: 富兰克林坦伯顿ChristyTan：韩国人工智能交易拥挤加杠杆，流动性风
speaker: Kristie Tan

segments.en: so we're looking at especially Korea I mean Korea is a very clean expression of the AI memory and semiconductor cycle and so when positioning becomes crowded volatility also rises and the added issue in Korea is leverage right
segments.zh: 特别是韩国，它是AI存储和半导体周期的典型代表。当仓位变得拥挤，波动率就会上升，而韩国还有一个额外问题——杠杆。

segments.en: so we're seeing that leverage single stock products can force same direction flows so buying to rallies and selling to declines which can amplify market moves especially when liquidity is not ample
segments.zh: 我们看到杠杆单一股票产品会引发同向资金流，追涨杀跌，从而放大市场波动，尤其是在流动性不足时。

segments.en: so I think at this point in time it's not just whether the fundamental story is attractive which we think it is the question is whether liquidity and position can absorb the flows
segments.zh: 因此目前的问题不仅是基本面故事是否吸引人（我们认为是的），而是流动性和仓位能否吸收这些资金流。

segments.en: and so how do we relate that to that inflation profile in Asia is that we are seeing a lot more tightness in I think policy direction so we're seeing you know Indonesia hiking rates and the other central banks including RBNZ are probably going to you know tighten policy to deal with the inflation risk
segments.zh: 这与亚洲通胀状况的关联在于，我们看到政策方向趋紧，印尼加息，其他央行如新西兰联储也可能收紧政策以应对通胀风险。

segments.en: and this comes at a time Chris when there's a lot of volatility in the equity markets as well Chris they wanted to dig a bit deeper into your views on South Korea because you say you know there's obviously the danger of just buying the index on the AI story which a lot of investors have done and it's a very compelling so right also a danger you say in looking our companies like Samsung and high necks with its ADR listing as well as a proxy for the South Korean markets
segments.zh: 而此时权益市场本身波动也很大。主持人想进一步了解你对韩国的看法，因为你说很多投资者仅因AI故事就买入指数，这很诱人但也有风险，包括将三星、SK海力士等公司视为韩国市场代表的风险。

segments.en: so how do you trade this market where are the opportunities and I guess the value that you can still find so a potential US listing would speak to global investor demand for AI supply chain exposure and deeper capital market access beyond the max seven but you know it does not remove the underlying cyclicality of semiconductors memory pricing or even concentration risks
segments.zh: 那么如何交易这个市场？机会和价值在哪里？潜在的美国上市反映了全球投资者对AI供应链敞口和更深入资本市场准入的需求，但这并未消除半导体、存储定价的周期性，甚至集中度风险。
